title: Rolling Dunes | KEY.co
description_expanded: Nestled in the heart of Florida's panoramic coastline, this vacation rental stands as a beacon of luxury and serenity on Winston Lane. The residence unfolds over three sumptuous floors, complemented by a charming carriage house for additional privacy and comfort. Designed for those who seek to bask in the glow of the Gulf without sacrificing the indulgences of a high-end abode, this home is a perfect blend of elegance and leisure. With four exquisite bedrooms in the main house and an additional serene bedroom in the carriage house, guests are guaranteed personal havens of rest. Each bedroom is a masterful retreat with its bath, offering privacy paired with flat-screen TVs and stylish interiors. The twin master suites crown the third floor, each boasting vaulted ceilings, opulent bedding, and en suite facilities that feature walk-in showers and separate, luxurious soaker tubs. The allure of this property extends beyond its walls to a verdant backyard oasis, where a private pool invites guests to plunge into its refreshing embrace. Here, leisure is elevated with loungers for sunbathing, a grill for culinary exploits, and ample space for spirited beach games. Inside, the chef's kitchen beckons with stainless steel appliances and an additional beverage fridge, perfect for stashing cold drinks and snacks. This space flows into an al fresco dining patio and a grand dining room, setting the scene for memorable feasts and convivial gatherings. And for those moments of separation or togetherness, the home thoughtfully provides dual living rooms - allowing the kids to revel upstairs, while adults unwind in the sophisticated tranquility of the main floor.
